scripts/refresh_directory_guides.py

Python · Tier B

Refresh folder inventories from existing source prose and reviewed editorial descriptions.

Details

Run from the checkout with --write to update README inventory blocks and the provenance ledger. Without --write, report changed paths and exit nonzero when inventories are stale. The command never imports the inspected product modules, starts services or infers semantic review from the presence of a description.
